title: What It Really Costs to Own a Pagani
description:
A Pagani Utopia launched in twenty twenty-two at about two point one nine million dollars. According to a price guide, a twenty twenty-four car with just forty-eight kilometres on the clock was sold at auction in Zurich in October twenty twenty-five for about four million dollars. So the strange truth about owning a Pagani may be this: the cost is not what you lose. It is what you gain. But there is a catch, and it is the reason this video exists. Service visits are reported at fifteen to forty thousand dollars each. Insurance has no published price. And nobody can walk into a showroom and buy one. We will go through every number we could find, and tell you clearly what we could not.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
